# WS4

> Agent-facing index for WS4. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Compiled dataset](reference/compiled-dataset.html): the runtime contract, its tables, and its invariants.
- [ForestModelXML recipe](reference/forestmodelxml.html): the recipe format, the matrix builder, legacy ingestion, and the known gaps.
- [Simulator](reference/simulator.html): the annual-step engine, its schedule, and its run outputs.
- [Optimizer](reference/optimizer.html): the objective and its targets (including even flow and non-declining yield), the operator registry, the metaheuristics, and the MIP bound.
- [Spatial structure and constraints](reference/spatial.html): the block topology, patch metrics, and opening and green-up rules.
- [Roads](reference/roads.html): the network tables, shortest-path routing, and the route outputs.
- [Performance and scale](reference/performance.html): the measured figures, the incremental objective, and how to reproduce the benchmark.
- [API reference](api/index.html): the repository tooling's public functions, with their parameters, types, and return values. The package API is rendered on the reference pages above.
